title: Lithium-supplementing composite diaphragm, preparation method and application
abstract: The invention discloses a lithium-supplementing composite diaphragm, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the technical field of lithium secondary batteries. The ceramic layer and the ceramic-lithium supplement layer are respectively arranged on the two sides of the base film of the lithium supplement composite diaphragm, so that on one hand, the temperature resistance of the diaphragm can be improved, the thermal shrinkage of the diaphragm can be improved, the occurrence of short-circuit accidents can be reduced, on the other hand, lithium ions consumed in the charging and discharging process can be timely supplemented, the ion transmission rate can be increased, and the structural stability of the lithium battery in the circulating process can be improved. According to the invention, the lithium supplement layer is arranged on the surface of the ceramic layer, so that potential safety hazards caused by micropore blockage due to direct contact of metal lithium powder and the base film can be avoided, and meanwhile, the ceramic layer can play a role in buffering and heat dissipation, and is beneficial to improving the safety of the lithium powder in the use process. Meanwhile, the lithium battery adopts a net-shaped current collector, so that lithium ions can be ensured to rapidly pass through the positive plate and the negative plate, and a high-speed passage is provided for timely supplementing the lithium ions.
